body: I’m reading We Make the Road by Walking as my morning devotions. I cannot describe the impact this wonderful work is having on me. I refer to it as “manna” in a very real sense: “What is it?” Is it devotional, yes. Is it biblical study and profound scholarship, yes. It is so many things, so beautifully written, solidly researched and deeply moving and defied traditional categories. Whatever it is, it is nourishing me. I hope to share it with others in our church who are seeking a deeper experience of this faith we call Christianity.
